subject: Re: Ops onboarding & governance for Pinecone <> Redwood storage sync
messages:
From: Alex Moreno <alex@pineconesolutions.io>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Soma Consulting <kate@soma-consulting.com>; platform-infra@clientcorp.com
Date: Mon, 10 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pinecone <> Redwood — ops onboarding & checklist

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for the intro. We're excited to move forward with a tighter ops integration between Pinecone and Redwood for your shared customers (especially for the ClientCorp proof-of-concept). Before we get on a call, I wanted to share a short checklist so your engineering and CS teams can confirm the items we'll cover: 

- Index replication and multi-region read routing expectations
- Cold-tiering with S3: manifest format and hydration latency targets
- Auth & key rotation patterns for cross-service access
- Telemetry hooks: trace/span keys we can consume for root-cause analysis
- Emergency evacuation / index rehousing runbook (RTO targets)

I've attached our onboarding checklist and a one-page operations note. Can you confirm who from Redwood will own these items and whether we should include your legal team for the SLA draft?

Appreciate it — happy to schedule a working session next week.

Cheers,
Alex
Alex Moreno
Partner Engineer, Pinecone Solutions
Attachment: pinecone_onboarding_checklist.pdf (PDF, 78 KB)
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Moreno <alex@pineconesolutions.io>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Apr 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pinecone <> Redwood — ops onboarding & checklist

Alex — thanks for the checklist, very helpful. Quick answers inline below and some asks so we can scope the working session: 

- Owners: Infra (Vanessa) will lead replication policy + routing; Product Ops (Marissa) will lead SLA language and onboarding workbook. I will coordinate with ClientCorp for timelines.
- Cold-tiering: Redwood's S3 materialization uses a chunked manifest (we'll attach a sample). Target hydration SLA we agreed internally is 3–5s for warmed prefixes, and 20s worst-case for a cold restore — we'll want to validate that with your read-path.
- Auth: We prefer short-lived service tokens via our KMS-backed broker (no static keys). Can your connector support token exchange (OAuth2 client_credentials with JWT bearer)?
- Telemetry: we can emit a service tag header x-rdw-trace that maps across our traces. We'll share schema.
- Evacuation: Vanessa will draft the runbook template; can Pinecone confirm acceptable RTO buckets so we can align?

Can we do a 60-minute sync on Thursday 4/13 at 10am PT? If that doesn't work Vanessa suggested the 14th afternoon.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Senior Partner Success Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Alex Moreno <alex@pineconesolutions.io>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Soma Consulting <kate@soma-consulting.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Apr 2028 08:20:00 -0700

On Wed, Apr 11, 2028 at 11:03 AM Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Alex — thanks for the checklist, very helpful. Quick answers inline below and some asks so we can scope the working session:
>
> - Owners: Infra (Vanessa) will lead replication policy + routing; Product Ops (Marissa) will lead SLA language and onboarding workbook. I will coordinate with ClientCorp for timelines.
>
Thanks Rachel — 10am PT on Thu 4/13 works for our team. We'll prepare a short tech brief covering:

- replication modes (hot/hybrid/replicated shards) and expected 99th latency tradeoffs
- S3 manifest format we recommend; we'll include a transformation script if your chunk format differs
- token exchange: yes, we support OAuth2 client_credentials + JWT; need a JWKS endpoint for Redwood's broker
- RTO buckets: we can sign off on 1/30/90 day buckets in the runbook, will confirm exact RTO numbers in the meeting after we see traffic patterns

Attaching our Ops checklist and a draft SLA template (rdw-pinecone-sla-draft-v1.docx) so Marissa can annotate.

Alex
Attachment: rdw-pinecone-sla-draft-v1.docx (DOCX, 42 KB)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Moreno <alex@pineconesolutions.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Apr 2028 12:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pinecone <> Redwood — ops onboarding & checklist

Thanks team — quick operational notes ahead of today's sync: 

- Meeting confirmed 4/13 10:00–11:00 PT (dial-in + shared doc at https://drive.company/shared/0B1pOnboarding/rdw-pinecone-ops)
- Pre-reads: Rachel will drop our S3 manifest sample to the drive before the call; Alex please highlight any deviations vs your recommended schema so we can scope a transformation shim if needed.
- Goal for call: agree replication policy defaults for PLG customers, define escalations for index rehousing, and surface any security QA items that require legal review.
- Action owner matrix (high level):
  - Replication policy: Vanessa (Redwood) / Alex (Pinecone)
  - SLA language: Marissa (Redwood) / Pinecone legal (TBD)
  - Token exchange: Infra engs to exchange JWKS endpoints (task)
  - ClientCorp POC: Rachel to coordinate test plan and acceptance criteria

I'll run the meeting and capture open items; Marissa — please flag any non-standard commercial asks in the SLA so we can route to finance.

Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Dedicated Partnerships, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Moreno <alex@pineconesolutions.io>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Fri, 20 Apr 2028 17:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pinecone <> Redwood — ops onboarding & checklist (Follow-up & mutual action items)

Alex / team — great sync earlier this week. Quick follow-ups and mutual action items captured here so ClientCorp's POC can proceed next week: 

1) Action: Pinecone to share shard replication heatmap doc and a sample transformed manifest by EOD Mon 4/23. (Alex)
2) Action: Redwood infra to publish JWKS endpoint and test token exchange in staging by Thu 4/26. (Vanessa / infra)
3) Action: Marissa will post annotated SLA (rdw-pinecone-sla-draft-v1.docx) with commercial sticky points clearly flagged — review cycle 48 hours. (Marissa)
4) Action: ClientCorp to provide a representative corpus and query profile by Tue 4/24 so we can size the test harness. (platform-infra@clientcorp.com)

Notes: We agreed internally that cold restore hydrating for large prefixes will be targeted at 20s worst-case but we will validate in the POC and consider a warmed-prefix cache in front of Pinecone for hot documents. Also flagged: observability key mapping — Alex will propose a tracer mapping table.

Attachments: meeting-notes-20280413.txt (summary), rdw-pinecone-sla-draft-v1.docx (annotated)

We'll open a shared Jira board (link in Drive) for the runbook tasks — I'll post it this afternoon. Thanks all,

Marissa Cole
Product Operations Lead, Redwood Inference
